text.en: <good>Go.</good> <muted>No {@terms.player, n=1} can hurt you for <emphasis>{@values.duration.seconds, n=seconds}</emphasis>. After that, friendly fire is on.</muted>
text.de: <good>Los.</good> <muted>Kein {@terms.player, n=1} kann dich <emphasis>{@values.duration.seconds, n=seconds}</emphasis> lang verletzen. Danach ist Friendly Fire an.</muted>
